title: Complete skills/learning palette: repetition correction, practice deliveries and carrier/title limits
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete learning palette with explicit novelty correction, delivered practice evidence and later proposed ladders
reviews.disposition:
All 723 input lines were read, including SLC1–SLC122, SLX1–SLX2, SLA/SLN/SLL tables, the complete SLL7/SLL11/SLL12 evidence, carrier/clock refinement, recovered Corc additions and EL22–EL41. The opening proposed-rulebook label is historical: the old SKILL_AND_LEARNING_RULES path is now a four-line router to DOMAIN_RULES, whose SLR1–SLR43 register and carrier qualifications govern current use. This is not adoption of every adjacent palette row or a fresh source/gameplay verification.

The useful learning lens separates understanding, practiced fluency, current expression and any real source, without demanding three bars or merging native skill_progress and simulation powers. SLC105 and the current SLR20/SLR37 qualifications supersede body-only shorthand: soul, memory, construct, direct transfer or an actual cheat can carry whichever faculty its mechanism changes. A stolen/copied/sealed memory and a transferred power have different owners and loss semantics; ordinary knowledge transfer need not confer trained execution, but a real mechanism may grant both. SLC5/SLC37 already correct the initial missing-cause allegation: simulation power grants have cause and lineage, unlike the inspected native skill progress. The two-store/source/compiler observations are dated, not a current exhaustive inventory.

SLX1 explicitly corrects the first-round novelty overreach. Repeated observation need not reveal new facts, while genuine repeated work can keep improving fluency, efficiency and reliability. Native per-tick XP remains legitimate. Challenge bands, low feedback, rust, boredom, memory fading and mistaken habits are world/skill dials rather than compulsory plateaus or punishment for idle play. An executions counter supplies this built method's practice input; its existence alone does not certify that every command represented meaningful practice or that every skill shares the same curve. Mental rehearsal, sleep, dream practice, grants and direct-transfer methods act on their actual carriers/clock, without forcing body training or mandatory intermediate steps for a stronger means.

SLL7 first proves paid, present, focus-funded coached practice and native persistence at its version, but its mastery-4 limit is later superseded. SLL11 derives cutting duration from existing executions, using the pre-run quote for the accepted job; its integer-minute curve reaches a one-minute floor and does not improve every stat forever. SLL12 then removes the drill wall, adds positive fractional mastery with a floor and double coached gains, shows mastery/use counts and passes the dated native browser/persistence route. Those later results close the earlier SLL8/use-count gaps, not generic blocked-reason projection or absent coaches for the other three methods. The shown browser input is DOM-clicked, with explicit fixtures; old 1366 evidence does not replace current UI_RULES desktop targets. Early rule-check failures and one uncaptured full-suite failure remain in history beside later passing checks. No historical commit/push instruction or SHA grants current publication authority.

SLC38/SLL4 second-consumer wording is refined by AD51: extract/register the first useful shared seam when selected; another consumer validates or revises it rather than supplying permission to begin. SLC69's first-milestone premise is retired by the October24 direction. Old-save compatibility deferral is not permission to corrupt current pending jobs, erase unrelated progress or skip current-state reload/import proof. Lessons, teacher participation/focus, tuition and actual time retain their existing transaction owners; a frozen teacher cannot supply service. Interrupted performed learning preserves acquired results and settles actual paid segments. The proposed dojo progression offers feedback, practical application and recognition, not a compulsory seven-step ladder, new combat school or universal tuition-to-mastery conversion.

CRL49/CRL50's later continuation receipt supersedes their initial unimplemented status for the bounded book/home collection and read/stop/rate/ETA routes: one and two physical copies give the same local support, removing a copy preserves learned progress, and existing book/clock owners retain accumulated work. This review reads the saved evidence statement, not that linked receipt or live runtime anew. SLC106's smooth curve is a possible alternative calculation; a second curve is not inherently a third ledger if it derives from the same authoritative progress. SLC107–SLC110 absorption/study/away-bank shapes and queue length/rates remain proposed dials, not imported closed-game constants or current running queues. Actual pool and bank represent different quantities and should not be conflated merely to avoid duplicate state.

SLC112–SLC118 distinguish derived perks, recorded recognition and separately owned cross-skill edges; rust/current level/peak and genuine permanent faculties follow the actual benefit. An unwitnessed deed may still have an actual system, self-granted or other recognizer when its world supports it. SLC115 cannot impose an external-witness requirement on every designation. A proposed locked row must not enumerate sealed future content, thresholds or counts merely because a real grant exists; current AD3/means/knowledge rules govern what is shown. Independent real rewards may both pay under SLR43, while one milestone/title announcement must not double the same effect. Table revision and content hash are compatibility inputs, not a mandatory respec or a promise that every old save remains correct without a concrete policy. New Sleeping/Patience ladders, lead timelines, title/witness slices and external constants remain candidates, not implemented by saving the round.

Current [DOMAIN_RULES](DOMAIN_RULES.md), [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md), [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md) and actual learning/reading/title/continuation owners govern selected work. Retain all useful learning causes, repeated gains, carried faculties, institutional choices and original evidence/history. No practice, title, book, state owner, counter, migration, new rule or runtime change is executed here.
reviews.evidence: Actual complete723line reading in six contiguous ranges; actual moved-rule stub, scoped DOMAIN_RULES SLR rows and RULES_INDEX authority/register entries inspected. No linked continuation receipt, current runtime, private saves, browser or external source newly verified.
reviews.reopen: Keep current SLR carrier/clock/repetition authority and exact dated practice evidence; selected future work needs actual consumer, source, pending-work compatibility and disclosure scope rather than old caps or proposed queue claims.
